description: South Korean artistic gymnast Yeo Seo-jeong won gold in the women's vault at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Thursday, giving the country its first title in the sport. description: For millions of South Koreans, Chuseok means packing bags, loading up the car and joining the “great migration” as families crisscross the country to reunite with relatives. Across the border, Chuseok looks both surprisingly familiar and markedly different. North Koreans also make songpyeon, visit their ancestors' graves, share food with relatives and play traditional games such as ssireum and yutnori. description: MEXICO CITY-- South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said combining the country's technology with Mexico's strong industrial base can create new growth, citing artificial intelligence and supply chains among areas for cooperation, a media interview showed Wednesday. "For Korean companies, Mexico is much more than a production base: it is a key strategic platform for accessing the markets of North America and the rest of the world," Lee said in an interview with the Mexican newspaper El Universal.
title: Lee says combining S. Korea's technology with Mexico's industrial base can create new growth
